description: ADO-SCHEMA Fields.Refresh against a definition change (read/write copy): a server keyset read-only and a client static read-only Recordset of SELECT * FROM W each read Fields.Count and call Fields.Refresh (Count); ALTER TABLE W ADD COLUMN X TEXT(10) executes on the Connection (Errors); each Recordset reads Count, calls Fields.Refresh and reads Count, Requery and Count, and reads Fields.Item("X") Name; a new Recordset of SELECT * FROM W reads Count; the first Recordset then closes and Fields.Refresh is called on the retained collection.
